q: I ____ Amy since we were six years old.
explain: since 引导一段延续到现在的时间，用现在完成时 have known

q: Amy ____ my best friend since childhood.
explain: since childhood 表示从过去持续至今，用 has been

q: We ____ many happy moments together.
explain: 强调过去到现在的经历，用现在完成时 have shared

q: ____ he finished his homework yet?
explain: 主语 he 用 Has，yet 常与现在完成时连用

q: We have ____ quarrelled in all these years.
explain: never 表示“从未”，常用于现在完成时肯定句

q: Have you ever ____ an online friend in real life?
explain: 现在完成时用过去分词 met

q: I have ____ forgiven him, so don't worry.
explain: already 用于现在完成时肯定句，表示“已经”

q: She ____ visited her grandma for a long time.
explain: for a long time 与现在完成时连用，否定用 hasn't

q: Look! Amy ____ her new photos online.
explain: just 表示“刚刚”，用现在完成时 has just posted

q: We have been good friends ____ ten years.
explain: for + 一段时间（ten years），since + 时间点

q: I ____ London last summer.
explain: last summer 是明确的过去时间，用一般过去时 visited

q: We ____ from Guangzhou to London.
explain: 叙述过去发生的旅程，用一般过去时 flew

q: ____ you ever tried fish and chips?
explain: ever 强调至今的经历，用现在完成时 Have you tried

q: She has just ____ a plane ticket.
explain: 现在完成时用过去分词 bought

q: He ____ packing his suitcase yet.
explain: yet 用于现在完成时否定句，hasn't finished

q: I ____ to Beijing three times.
explain: “截至现在去过几次”用现在完成时 have been

q: We ____ the British Museum two days ago.
explain: ago 表示明确过去时间，用一般过去时 visited

q: “I have been to London.” 这句话的意思是：
explain: have been to 表示“曾去过某地（人已回来）”

q: They ____ to a new city in 2023.
explain: in 2023 是过去时间点，用一般过去时 moved

q: Have you ____ a great time since you arrived?
explain: since 引导现在完成时，用过去分词 had

q: Many animals ____ by law.
explain: 被动语态 be + 过去分词，are protected

q: Pandas ____ by people all over the world.
explain: 熊猫“被喜爱”，用被动语态 are loved

q: The little dog ____ on the street.
explain: 过去的被动语态 was + 过去分词 found

q: Food ____ to the pets every morning.
explain: 食物“被给予”，用被动 is given

q: 主动句 “People protect pandas.” 改为被动：Pandas ____ by people.
explain: 被动语态 are + 过去分词 protected

q: Forests ____ every day.
explain: 现在进行时的被动：are being + 过去分词

q: This rare species ____ at last.
explain: 现在完成时的被动：has been + 过去分词

q: 被动语态的结构是 ____ + 过去分词。
explain: 被动语态 = be + 过去分词

q: The window ____ by Tom yesterday.
explain: yesterday 表过去，被动用 was broken

q: English ____ in many countries.
explain: 英语“被说”，用被动 is spoken

q: If we plant more trees, the air ____ cleaner.
explain: 第一条件句：if + 一般现在时，主句 will + 动词原形

q: If you cut down forests, deserts ____ bigger.
explain: 真实未来条件，主句用 will grow

q: If I ____ a tree, I would live for a thousand years.
explain: 第二条件句（非真实）if 从句所有人称都用 were

q: If there ____ no trees, many animals would die.
explain: 虚拟非真实条件，be 动词用 were

q: 第一条件句主句结构：If + 一般现在时, ____ + 动词原形。
explain: 真实未来条件主句用 will + 动词原形

q: 在第一条件句的 if 从句里不能用 ____。
explain: if 从句用一般现在时表将来，不用 will

q: If it ____ tomorrow, we won't plant trees.
explain: if 从句用一般现在时 rains 表将来

q: We will have cleaner air if everyone ____ a tree.
explain: everyone 是第三人称单数，从句用 plants

q: If I were you, I ____ recycle the old books.
explain: 第二条件句主句用 would + 动词原形

q: 下列哪句是非真实（第二）条件句？
options: If I had wings, I would fly.
If it rains, I will stay.
If you study, you will pass.
explain: if + 过去时 + would 是非真实条件句

q: We ____ turn off the tap when brushing our teeth.
explain: should 表建议“应该”

q: You ____ boil the water before drinking it.
explain: must 表必须（必要性）

q: We ____ throw rubbish into the river.
explain: mustn't 表禁止“不准”

q: should 表示：
explain: should = 给建议，表示“这样做更好”

q: mustn't 表示：
explain: mustn't = 禁止，不允许

q: You ____ waste water, even one drop.
explain: 不准浪费水，用 mustn't 表禁止

q: We ____ protect our rivers from pollution.
explain: must 表必须保护河流

q: You ____ drink at least six glasses of water every day.
explain: 给健康建议用 should

q: must 表示：
explain: must = 必须，表示必要性

q: 下列哪句表示“禁止”？
explain: mustn't 表禁止

q: I ____ TV when the power went out.
explain: 过去某刻正在进行的动作用过去进行时 was watching

q: They ____ dinner when the lights came back.
explain: 主语 they 用 were + V-ing

q: At 8 p.m. last night, I ____ my homework.
explain: 过去具体时刻正在进行，用过去进行时

q: While Dad ____ candles, Mum was telling stories.
explain: while 引导两个同时进行的动作，用过去进行时

q: When I ____ my phone, the power cut off.
explain: “正在充电时”用过去进行时 was charging

q: 过去进行时的结构是 ____ + 动词-ing。
explain: 过去进行时 = was/were + V-ing

q: ____ you reading at 9 p.m. last night?
explain: 主语 you 用 Were

q: I ____ sleeping; I was still studying.
explain: 过去进行时否定用 wasn't + V-ing

q: The children ____ in the garden at that time.
explain: at that time 表过去某刻，用过去进行时

q: 过去进行时常和哪些词搭配？
options: when 和 while 都可以
explain: 过去进行时常与 when / while 连用

q: The poet ____ wrote this poem is Li Bai.
explain: 先行词是人（poet），关系词用 who

q: The poem ____ I like most is Quiet Night Thoughts.
explain: 先行词是物（poem），关系词用 which

q: The girl ____ sits next to me loves poems.
explain: 指人可用 that，作主语

q: This is the book ____ Mum gave me.
explain: 先行词是物且作宾语，用 that（可省略）

q: 定语从句中指“人”通常用 ____。
explain: who 用于指人

q: 定语从句中指“物”通常用 ____。
explain: which 用于指物

q: The song ____ we heard last night made me cry.
explain: 指物作宾语用 that（可省略）

q: 关系词 that 通常可以代替 ____。
explain: that 在多数情况下可代替 who 和 which

q: The man ____ is reading over there is my teacher.
explain: 先行词是人作主语，用 who

q: 下列哪句定语从句正确？
options: The poem that I read was nice.
The poem who I read was nice.
The poem where I read was nice.
explain: 指物用 that，who/where 在此都不对

q: ____ is his favourite hobby.
explain: 动名词 Cooking 作主语

q: He wants ____ a chef one day.
explain: want 后接动词不定式 to be

q: I enjoy ____ poems in my free time.
explain: enjoy 后接动名词 reading

q: She finished ____ her homework before dinner.
explain: finish 后接动名词 doing

q: I hope ____ London some day.
explain: hope 后接动词不定式 to visit

q: They decided ____ the old man.
explain: decide 后接动词不定式 to help

q: 动词 enjoy / finish / practise 后面接 ____。
explain: 这些动词后接动名词（V-ing）

q: 动词 want / hope / plan 后面接 ____。
explain: 这些动词后接动词不定式（to + 动词）

q: It is fun ____ new skills.
explain: It is + 形容词 + to do 结构，用不定式

q: “I stopped ____.”（意为“我不再吃了”）
explain: stop doing 表示停止正在做的事
